AnalysisConfig.title: AnalysisConfig

Engine parameters. Defaults follow the project brief (EMA 20/50,
MA 200) and are tuned for intraday 5-minute candles.

ContextConfig.title: ContextConfig
ContextConfig.description: How a pattern's surroundings are measured.

EntryConfirmation.title: EntryConfirmation
EntryConfirmation.description:
Whether the entry timeframe currently agrees with the
higher-timeframe bias. Descriptive only: not an order trigger.

EntryType.title: EntryType
EntryType.description:
How a candidate's entry is executed.

MARKET: enter at the next price after the signal candle has closed
        (breakout momentum, mean reversion: the closed candle is the
        confirmation).
STOP:   enter only if price trades through `entry_candidate` (the
        trigger) within `entry_valid_bars` candles; otherwise no trade.
        Used where the setup's own definition is "enter beyond a level"
        (trend continuation: beyond the confirmation candle).

FactorScore.title: FactorScore
FactorScore.description:
One 0-100 factor in the "market brain" panel. Some factors are
directional (50 = neutral) and some measure intensity; `scale`
says which, so a score is never read out of context.

LevelStrengthWeights.title: LevelStrengthWeights
LevelStrengthWeights.description:
Points each component contributes to the 0-100 Level Strength
Score. They are normalised by their sum, so any positive values work.

ScoringConfig.title: ScoringConfig
ScoringConfig.description:
Weights are points. Note the brief's initial weights add up to 95,
not 100 (15+15+15+10+10+10+10+5+5); they are kept exactly as given
and the score is scaled to 100 regardless. A component that does not apply to a strategy (retracement for a
breakout, for example) is left out, and the applicable weights are
scaled to sum to 100, so a score always means "share of the
applicable, weighted evidence present".

StrategyCheck.description:

TradeIntent.description: What the engine wants to do, before any order exists.

TradingMode.title: TradingMode
TradingMode.description:
Supported trading modes.

PAPER: fully simulated capital, orders, and fills. This is the
    mandatory default — see PROJECT_CONTRACT.md section 9.
APPROVAL: system proposes trades; a human must approve execution.
LIVE: real orders sent to a connected broker. Requires multiple
    simultaneous safety conditions before it may ever be used.

TradingSettingsUpdateRequest.title: TradingSettingsUpdateRequest
TradingSettingsUpdateRequest.description:
Fields a user may adjust in this phase.

Notably absent: `trading_mode` and `auto_trading_enabled`. Changing
trading mode is a safety-critical action (PROJECT_CONTRACT.md
section 9) that deserves its own explicit, audited endpoint once a
real trading engine exists to make that setting meaningful — not a
field on a generic settings PATCH.
